config.enableErrorHighlighting: Enable or disable error highlighting in Karel instruction files. Disable this for educational purposes where students should identify errors themselves.
config.executionSpeed: Execution speed in milliseconds between steps (50-2000ms). Lower values = faster execution.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Karel
walkthrough.description: Write your first Karel program, run it, and watch the robot move.
walkthrough.create.title: Create your first program
walkthrough.create.description:
Karel programs live in .kli files, and each program runs in a world (.klm).
[New Karel Program](command:vs-karel.newProgram)
walkthrough.run.title: Run it
walkthrough.run.description:
Open your .kli file and press F5 (or the ▶ button, or the ▶ Run link above BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM). The world opens beside your code and Karel moves.
[Run Program](command:vs-karel.run)
walkthrough.step.title: Step through it
walkthrough.step.description:
Press F10 to execute one instruction at a time. The current line is highlighted while the world updates in sync — perfect for understanding loops.
[Step](command:vs-karel.step)
walkthrough.worlds.title: Edit worlds
walkthrough.worlds.description:
Worlds are simple JSON files with autocomplete and validation. Change the beepers or add walls, save, and the visualizer updates.
[New World](command:vs-karel.newWorld)
